FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc

			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc

		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month

		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		asset_class_base
	where
		business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		/*and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD', '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) )
		and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) )*/
)
select * from asset_class_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_asset_class_DEV"

/* QuickSight 17308165-5484-4c1b-bc39-67f65e00e283 */
SELECT "business_date", "abor_transaction_number", "abor_security_id", "sedol", "isin", "cusip", "esm_incorp_country_code", "security_name_id", "sst_custody_account_code", "model_portfolio_id", "business_transaction_code", "settlement_currency", "trade_date", "payment_date", "nominal", "nominal_basis", "elementary_transaction_code", "interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency", "interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency", "transaction_cancellation_flag", "reconciliation_status", "created_date", "party_id", "epm_party_name", "transaction_number_in_originating_system", "payment_amount_quotation_currency", "payment_amount_portfolio_currency", "external_short_tag", "settlement_date", "quotation_currency", "number_of_units", "cross_deal_indicator", "settlement_location", "esm_country_code", "country_ref_code", "esm_country_name", "esm_incorp_country_name", "portfolio_group_id", "abor_security_group_name", "abor_security_type_name", "model_portfolio_name", "country_ref_name", "quotation_currency_name", "price_qc", "price_pc", "fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency", "cppib_country_of_exposure_name", "cppib_currency_of_exposure_name", "portfolio_name", "portfolio_group_name", "investment_strategy_name", "investment_department_name", "abor_instrument_type_id", "investment_type_name", "investmentstructurelevel3", "investmentstructurelevel4", "abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency", "other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency", "abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency", "other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency", "portfolio_id", "ibor_reason", "abor_coupon_rate", "dividend_per_share", "borrowing_account", "coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency", "coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency", "coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency", "restitution_expected_portfolio_currency", "restitution_expected_quotation_currency", "restitution_expected_settlement_currency", "accrued_interest_portfolio_currency", "accrued_interest_quotation_currency", "current_value_portfolio_currency", "current_value_quotation_currency", "additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency", "additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency"
FROM (WITH RankedTransactions AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
						order by
							changed_date desc -- change date is actual loaded date so use this to get the latest data.
           ) AS rn
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    WHERE accounting_framework_id = 'PCLFWKMAIN'
),
JoinedData AS (
    SELECT 
        st.scd_transaction_number_primary_key,
        CAST(st.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,
        ROUND(st.abor_transaction_number) AS abor_transaction_number,
        st.abor_security_id,
        st.abor_security_number,
        st.abor_security_name,
        st.model_portfolio_id,
        st.portfolio_id,
        st.business_transaction_code,
        st.settlement_currency,
        CAST(st.trade_date AS DATE) AS trade_date,
        CAST(st.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date,
        st.nominal,
        st.nominal_basis,
        st.elementary_transaction_code,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
        st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
        st.reconciliation_status,
        CAST(CAST(st.created_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS created_date,
        st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
        st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.external_short_tag,
        CAST(st.settlement_date AS DATE) AS settlement_date,
        st.settlement_location,
        st.quotation_currency,
        st.number_of_units,
        st.price AS price_qc,
        st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS price_pc,
        st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_quotation_currency,
        st.current_value_portfolio_currency,
        st.current_value_quotation_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.ibor_reason,
        st.dividend_per_share,
        st.borrowing_account,
        st.rn,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') AND st.abor_security_name LIKE '%CAD%' THEN 'Y'
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') THEN 'N'
        END AS cross_deal_indicator,
        -- From joins
        es.sedol,
        es.isin,
        es.cusip,
        es.esm_incorp_country_code,
        es.security_name_id,
        es.esm_country_code,
        es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
        es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
        smp.sst_custody_account_code,
        smp.model_portfolio_name,
        smp.investment_strategy_name,
        smp.investment_department_name,
        ep.party_id,
        ep.epm_party_name,
        ss.abor_security_group_name,
        ss.abor_security_type_name,
        ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
        ss.investment_type_name,
        ss.abor_coupon_rate,
        rec.country_ref_code,
        rcc_exchange_country.country_name AS esm_country_name,
        rcc_incorp_country.country_name AS esm_incorp_country_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_id,
        sp.portfolio_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_name,
        rcc_trade_country.country_name AS country_ref_name,
        rcc.currency_name AS quotation_currency_name,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel3,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel4
    FROM RankedTransactions st
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN (
    	select distinct exchange_name, mic, business_date, country_ref_code
    	from reference.reference_exchange_codes
    	where exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
    ) rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT *,
		    ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number ORDER BY business_date DESC ) AS latest
		FROM (
			SELECT abor_transaction_number,
				business_date,
				transaction_cancellation_flag,
				trade_date,
				MAX(abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency) abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,

NULL as INSTRUMENTGROUPCODE,
scdh.abor_instrument_type as INSTRUMENTGROUPNAME,

scdh.security_group_name as INSTRUMENTSUBGROUPNAME,

	when mhl.cppib_sec_id  not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then 'CPPIBSEC_ID' 
	else 'SECURITY_NO'
end as holdingDecompositionIDTypeCode, 
scdh.scd_holding_key_id as TBT_HOLDINGKEY,
NULL as INSTRUMENTGROUPCODE,
scdh.abor_instrument_type as INSTRUMENTGROUPNAME,
scdh.security_group_id as INSTRUMENTSUBGROUPCODE,
scdh.security_group_name as INSTRUMENTSUBGROUPNAME,
scdh.abor_security_type_id as INSTRUMENTTYPECODE,
scdh.abor_security_type_name as INSTRUMENTTYPENAME,
scdh.abor_security_name as INSTRUMENTNAMESOURCE,
(case when mhl.holding_level = 'Top Level' then scdh.abor_security_name else mhl.security_name end) as underlyingInstrumentNameSource,
(case when mhl.holding_level = 'Top Level' then scdh.abor_security_type_id 
      when mhl.holding_level <> 'Look Through' then NULL
--      else COALESCE(scds2.abor_security_type_id,COALESCE(mhl.security_type_name,scds.abor_security_type_id)) end) as underlyingInstrumentTypeCode,
      else COALESCE(scds3.abor_security_type_id,COALESCE(scds2.scd_sec_type,COALESCE(mhl.security_type_name,scds.abor_security_type_id))) end) as underlyingInstrumentTypeCode,
scdh.balance_nominal_number as quantity,
scdh.clean_price as currentPrice,
mhl.balance_nominal as underlyingQuantity,
COALESCE(mdsprice.current_price,abs(case when COALESCE(mhl.balance_nominal,0) = 0  then null
      when mhl.holding_level = 'Look Through' then round(mhl.total_market_value_qc/mhl.balance_nominal,6) 
      else null end)) as underlyingPrice,
(sum(case when leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_qc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id)) as marketValue,
scdh.quotation_currency_code as quotedCurrencyCode,
scdh.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as fxRateQuotedInCAD,
(sum(case when mhl.leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_pc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id)) as marketValuePC,
'CAD' as portfoliocurrencyCode,
0 as faceValue,
NULL as optionDelta,
(case when mhl.holding_level = 'Top Level' or mhl.underlying_index_name in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then NULL 
		else mhl.underlying_index_name end) as referenceIndex,
upper(mhl.holding_level) as lookthroughLevelType,
abs(case when mhl.holding_level = 'Top Level' THEN 1
           when mhl.holding_level = 'Look Through' and --mhl.leg_no = 1 and 
           (sum(case when leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_qc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id) ) <> 0
           then
              mhl.total_market_value_qc/(sum(case when leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_qc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id) )
           when mhl.holding_level = 'Look Through' and 
           (sum(case when leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_qc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id) ) = 0  
		      and COALESCE(mhl.balance_nominal,0) <> 0 then 1
		   else Null end)  as  underlyingWeight
from holdings.scd_holdings_main scdh
join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp on smp.business_date  = scdh.business_date  and smp.model_portfolio_id = scdh.model_portfolio_id 
join holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough_extended mhl on  mhl.business_Date  = cast(scdh.business_Date as date) and scdh.scd_holding_key_id = mhl.parent_holding_key
left outer join reference.scd_securities scds on scdh.business_Date = scds.business_Date and scdh.abor_security_number =  scds.abor_security_number
left outer join reference.scd_securities scds3 on scdh.business_Date = scds3.business_Date and  cast(mhl.cppib_sec_id as varchar) =  scds3.cppib_sec_id
left outer join asset.asset_security_identifiers scds2 on mhl.business_Date  = scds2.business_Date and  mhl.cppib_sec_id =  cast(scds2.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
left outer join mdsprice on mhl.cppib_sec_id = cast(mdsprice.cppib_sec_id as varchar) and trim(upper(mdsprice.currency_code)) = trim(upper(scdh.quotation_currency_code))
--left outer join indxconstprice on mhl.cppib_sec_id = cast(indxconstprice.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
where scdh.business_Date = '2025-06-24'  
and portfolio_calculation_id = 'RISK METRICS_DAILY'
and portfolio_group_id = 'CPPIB GROUP'
and upper(trim(scdh.abor_security_type_id)) in ('TRSEQIC', 'TRSILB', 'TRSFIIC', 'TRSEQ') 
and /* exclude zero-balance holdings */
NOT
(
COALESCE(scdh.clean_value_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.balance_nominal_number,0) =0 and
COALESCE(scdh.accrued_interest_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and

COALESCE(scdh.balance_nominal_number_unsettled,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.next_coupon_quotation_currency,0) = 0 
)
order by scdh.scd_holding_key_id
) order by TBT_HOLDINGKEY, ID_holdingDecomposition

/* cppi::14a62454e2a5e42dc9e593b289601c3b8f602e8c3ec16aa02e902b5ce4f3013b */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 01 and 02
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 01:00:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'

			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'

			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc

			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc

		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted

)

	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 11 and 12
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 11:31:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::9b4f4932f51342af0e5bb68038a0a8d35830625c240391b2a4ac0039f32083a6 */
SELECT 
        s1.model_portfolio_id as Account, 
        s1.abor_maturity_date as Maturity, 
        REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(s1.abor_security_name, '_', 2), '/', '') AS Pair,
        s1.exposure_quotation_currency as Ccy1, 
        s2.exposure_quotation_currency as Ccy2,
        s1.business_date,
        s1.extract_time,
        s2.business_date as business_date_s2,
        s2.extract_time as extract_time_s2
    FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main s1  
    JOIN holdings.scd_holdings_main s2 
        ON s1.model_portfolio_id = s2.model_portfolio_id 
        AND s1.quotation_currency_code <> s2.quotation_currency_code 
        AND s1.abor_maturity_date = s2.abor_maturity_date
        AND s1.abor_security_number = s2.abor_security_number
        AND s1.abor_holdings_leg_no <> s2.abor_holdings_leg_no
    WHERE 
        s1.model_portfolio_id in ('TFMFXCM')
        AND s1.quotation_currency_code = SUBSTR(REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(s1.abor_security_name, '_', 2), '/', ''), 1, 3)
        AND DATE_DIFF('DAY', CURRENT_DATE, CAST(s1.abor_maturity_date AS DATE)) BETWEEN 0 AND 21
        AND CAST(s1.business_date AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' DAY
    HAVING 
        ABS(s1.exposure_quotation_currency) >= 10
        AND ABS(s2.exposure_quotation_currency) >= 10
    ORDER BY
        s1.model_portfolio_id, 
        s1.abor_maturity_date, 
        REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(s1.abor_security_name, '_', 2), '/', '')

    --------------------------------------
FROM
    credit_investment_private_trusted_uat.cashflows_all_transactions transactions
LEFT JOIN
    reference_uat.ci_sentry_security securities
ON
    transactions.security_identifier = securities.security_identifier
WHERE
    CAST(transactions.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-23' AS DATE)
AND
    CAST(securities.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-23' AS DATE)
AND
    TRY_CAST('2025-06-23' AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE (securities.start_date) AND DATE(securities.end_date)
--AND
--  TRY_CAST(transactions.trade_date AS DATE) >= TRY_CAST('2025-06-23' AS DATE)
-- TODO: confirm if this is just because there is no underlying data
-- or there is problem in the logic
AND
    transactions.transaction_type = 'transaction'
AND
    transactions.is_cancelled = 'False'
AND
    settlement_date = ''
AND
    -- Filter out the transaction codes that should be excluded
    transactions.transaction_code NOT IN (SELECT code FROM excluded_transaction_codes)

        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd

								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor

/* cppi::a37a9d4ebd6d3cfa91eaa8cd08c722f0e3f19bff58d9567d9806444176de8c34 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 13 and 14
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 13:50:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

WITH max_date AS (
            SELECT MAX(business_date) AS business_date
            FROM holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
        )

        -- aCPP Block
        SELECT 
            'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' AS dataset_id,
            md.business_date AS business_date,
            ROUND(
                SUM(
                    CASE 
                        WHEN lt.pool_name = 'Core Pool' THEN lt.total_market_value_pc * COALESCE(scdu_acpp.unitized_percentage, 0)
                        WHEN lt.pool_name = 'Supplementary Pool' THEN lt.total_market_value_pc * COALESCE(scdu_acpp_supp.unitized_percentage, 0)
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    SELECT SUM(total_market_value_pc)
                    FROM holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
                    WHERE business_date = (SELECT business_date FROM max_date)
                    AND pool_name IN ('aCPP Cash for Benefits', 'aCPP Units and Residual Cash')
                )
            , 7) / 1000000000.0 AS market_value_reporting_currency
        FROM 
            holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough lt
            JOIN max_date md ON lt.business_date = md.business_date
            LEFT JOIN finance_accounting.scd_unitization scdu_acpp
                ON lt.business_date = DATE(scdu_acpp.business_date)
                AND scdu_acpp.acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP'
                AND scdu_acpp.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE'
            LEFT JOIN finance_accounting.scd_unitization scdu_acpp_supp
                ON lt.business_date = DATE(scdu_acpp_supp.business_date)
                AND scdu_acpp_supp.acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP'
                AND scdu_acpp_supp.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP'
        WHERE 
            lt.pool_name IN ('Core Pool', 'Supplementary Pool')
        GROUP BY md.business_date

        UNION ALL

        -- bCPP Block
        SELECT 
            'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' AS dataset_id,
            md.business_date AS business_date,
            ROUND(
                SUM(
                    CASE 
                        WHEN lt.pool_name = 'Core Pool' THEN lt.total_market_value_pc * COALESCE(scdu_bcpp_core.unitized_percentage, 0)
                        WHEN lt.pool_name = 'Supplementary Pool' THEN lt.total_market_value_pc * COALESCE(scdu_bcpp_supp.unitized_percentage, 0)
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) +
                (
                    SELECT SUM(total_market_value_pc)
                    FROM holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
                    WHERE business_date = (SELECT business_date FROM max_date)
                    AND pool_name IN ('bCPP Cash for Benefits', 'bCPP Units and Residual Cash')
                )
            , 7) / 1000000000.0 AS market_value_reporting_currency
        FROM 
            holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough lt
            JOIN max_date md ON lt.business_date = md.business_date
            LEFT JOIN finance_accounting.scd_unitization scdu_bcpp_core
                ON lt.business_date = DATE(scdu_bcpp_core.business_date)
                AND scdu_bcpp_core.acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP'
                AND scdu_bcpp_core.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE'
            LEFT JOIN finance_accounting.scd_unitization scdu_bcpp_supp
                ON lt.business_date = DATE(scdu_bcpp_supp.business_date)
                AND scdu_bcpp_supp.acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP'
                AND scdu_bcpp_supp.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP'
        WHERE 
            lt.pool_name IN ('Core Pool', 'Supplementary Pool')
        GROUP BY md.business_date

    party_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'Apr-F26' THEN summ_amt ELSE 0 END) AS "Apr-F26",

)

LEFT JOIN

ON
    transactions.security_identifier = securities.security_identifier
WHERE
    CAST(transactions.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-23' AS DATE)
AND
    CAST(securities.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-23' AS DATE)
AND
    TRY_CAST('2025-06-23' AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE (securities.start_date) AND DATE(securities.end_date)
--AND
--  TRY_CAST(transactions.trade_date AS DATE) >= TRY_CAST('2025-06-23' AS DATE)
-- TODO: confirm if this is just because there is no underlying data
-- or there is problem in the logic
AND
    transactions.transaction_type = 'transaction'
AND
    transactions.is_cancelled = 'False'
AND
    settlement_date = ''
AND
    -- Filter out the transaction codes that should be excluded
    transactions.transaction_code NOT IN (SELECT code FROM excluded_transaction_codes)
